$comment: Single source of truth for the SPA's security headers. Run `npm run security:headers` after editing (or after changing the boot script in src/index.html) to regenerate angular.json (dev server) and nginx/security-headers.conf (production). `npm run check:csp` fails on any drift. HSTS is not listed here: nginx sends it only for HTTPS requests (see nginx/default.conf.template).
